reason: Widens four platform/provider CHECK constraints to accept MiniMax while preserving every value accepted by the deployed 0.2.3 release. No columns or rows are removed.
risk: Replacing and validating CHECK constraints locks quota, route, monitor and template tables. The gate classifies DROP CONSTRAINT as cleanup even though each replacement is a superset.
mitigation: Keep each DROP and ADD in the existing migration transaction so validation failure rolls back the replacement. Require the deployed compatibility commit through the active-image ancestry gate and verify candidate health before switching traffic. This follow-up records the review of the upstream SQL already merged into main; the original failed CI must not be used as deployment evidence.
approved_by: Codex automated review for production deployment requested by hang
